## 🏅 Gold Tier Loyalty Program — Policy Summary

### Qualification Criteria
- **Flight Segments:** Minimum of 40 qualifying one-way segments per calendar year, **OR**
- **Tier Miles:** Accumulate 50,000+ tier-qualifying miles per calendar year, **OR**
- **Spending Threshold:** $12,000+ in eligible fare spend per calendar year

### Gold Tier Benefits

| Benefit                        | Details                                                        |
|--------------------------------|----------------------------------------------------------------|
| **Priority Check-in**         | Dedicated Gold counter at all hub airports                     |
| **Baggage Allowance**         | 2 free checked bags (up to 50 lbs each); 1 additional free bag on international flights |
| **Lounge Access**             | Complimentary access to partner lounges worldwide; 2 guest passes per year |
| **Priority Boarding**         | Zone 1 boarding on all flights                                 |
| **Seat Upgrades**             | Complimentary same-day upgrades (subject to availability)      |
| **Bonus Miles**               | 75% bonus miles on all qualifying flights                      |
| **Award Booking Discount**    | 10% fewer miles required on award redemptions                  |
| **Dedicated Support Line**    | 24/7 Gold-priority customer service hotline                    |
| **Guaranteed Reservations**   | Confirmed seat on sold-out flights (booked 48+ hrs in advance) |
| **Mileage Expiration Waiver** | Miles never expire while Gold status is active                 |

### Status Retention
- Gold status is valid for the **qualifying year + the following calendar year**.
- A **90-day grace period** applies if re-qualification requirements are not met.
- Members within 10% of re-qualification can request a **one-time status extension** (subject to review).
